notes: M21 G2 spec: Basri's Aegis. On resolution the caster may search the graveyard for Basri, Devoted Paladin and put it into hand. The card starts in the graveyard (not the library, so the runner's opening draw cannot fake the result). Re-pinned 2026-11-05 (strict decision words): B-78 (10f41df) asks the and/or zone choice after the may, and no word of the old queue ('fire', 'yes', 'pal') is one it offers: the silent fallback answered it ('yes' never answered any ask). '0' searches the library and the graveyard, the only reading when this pack was written; the pick itself is not asked, because one card in the world has the name, so 'pal' is gone.
